content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IGRUA Assistant Aerodrome Officer Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 08-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi (IGRUA) located in Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, to fill various contractual positions in the aviation field.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post being offered in this notification?
faq.answer: The post being offered is Assistant Aerodrome Officer under advertisement number IGRUA/ADVT/32/2026, offering candidates a great opportunity in the aviation sector.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies available for the Assistant Aerodrome Officer post, all offered on a contractual employment basis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for the Assistant Aerodrome Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a valid CPL/ATPL Holder or an ATC officer of AAI/Indian Defense Forces to be eligible to apply for this position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit criteria for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is set at 55 years as on 01.06.2026. Candidates should verify their age before submitting their application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a basic salary of ₹40,000 per month, along with a Transport Allowance of ₹1,800 per month and an Aviation Allowance of ₹300 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of applications via email is 08 October 2026. All applications must be submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for IGRUA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted exclusively through email to [email protected] by combining all necessary documents into a single PDF file.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Aerodrome Officer positions involves shortlisting of candidates followed by a written test or interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification?
faq.answer: You can check the official website at www.igrua.gov.in and download the notification PDF from the important links section provided in the article.
